name: PipelineTerraformPolicyCheck
description: Evaluate OPA or Sentinel policies from a directory or git repo against Terraform plan JSON, or run a policy repository's own tests (OPA, Sentinel, Terraform Policy)
author: sethbacon

inputs.name: mode
inputs.label: Mode
inputs.helpMarkDown: evaluate: check a Terraform plan against the policies. test: run the policy repository's own tests and publish each test case, so a broken policy fails the policy repository's pipeline. In test mode the input file and the evaluation options do not apply, and violationCount counts failed tests.

options.evaluate: Evaluate a plan against the policies

inputs.name: engine
inputs.label: Policy engine
inputs.helpMarkDown: Which policy engine to evaluate with. Install it first with the Pipeline policy agent installer task. tfpolicy (Terraform Policy) is only for mode test: Terraform evaluates Terraform Policy itself, through PipelineTerraformTask's policyPaths.

inputs.name: inputFile
inputs.label: Input file (plan JSON)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the JSON to evaluate, typically the output of 'terraform show -json <plan>' (e.g. $(TerraformShow.showFilePath)). Required in evaluate mode.

inputs.name: policyAgentPath
inputs.label: Policy agent path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional explicit path to the opa/sentinel binary. Defaults to the binary on the PATH.

inputs.name: policySource
inputs.label: Policy source
inputs.helpMarkDown: Where the policies come from.

inputs.name: policyPath
inputs.label: Policy directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Directory containing the policies (e.g. from a multi-repo checkout).

inputs.name: policyRepoUrl
inputs.label: Policy repo URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: HTTPS git URL of the policy repository.

inputs.name: policyRepoRef
inputs.label: Ref (branch, tag, or SHA)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Branch, tag, or full 40-character commit SHA to check out. Pin a SHA for supply-chain integrity.

inputs.name: policyRepoSubdir
inputs.label: Subdirectory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional subdirectory within the cloned repo that holds the policies.

inputs.name: policyRepoToken
inputs.label: Repo access token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional token for a private repo. Pass a pipeline secret variable; it is injected via http.extraheader and never written to the clone URL or logs.

inputs.name: hcpPolicySet
inputs.label: HCP Terraform policy set
inputs.helpMarkDown:
Treat the policy source as the root of an HCP Terraform policy set and evaluate it by that platform's rules, so a policy set written for HCP Terraform runs unchanged.

Sentinel: the set's own sentinel.hcl is used (its policies, a level per policy, parameters and modules), and the task supplies the tfplan/v2, tfconfig/v2 and tfstate/v2 imports from the plan JSON. An advisory failure warns, a soft-mandatory failure fails the step unless 'Override soft-mandatory failures' is set, a hard-mandatory failure always fails it. tfrun is not available. Requires a Sentinel release with the built-in Terraform plugins (verified with 0.41.0).

OPA: policies.hcl is used, the plan is passed as input.plan, each query must return an array and passes when it is empty, and a failure fails the step only for a mandatory policy. input.run is not provided.

The decision path, fail mode, default enforcement level, import name and custom sentinel.hcl inputs do not apply.

inputs.name: tfpolicyPoliciesDir
inputs.label: Terraform Policy: policies directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Directory of .policy.hcl files, relative to the policy source and inside it. tfpolicy does not search subdirectories. The default matches HashiCorp's recommended layout.

inputs.name: tfpolicyTestsDir
inputs.label: Terraform Policy: tests directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Directory of .policytest.hcl files, relative to the policy source and inside it. Set it to the policies directory when the tests sit beside the policies. tfpolicy fetches the providers the policies declare to check test data against their schemas, so the agent needs registry access or a provider mirror (PipelineTerraformProviderMirror).

inputs.name: decisionPath
inputs.label: Decision path
inputs.helpMarkDown: OPA decision to evaluate (data.<path>), e.g. terraform/deny.

inputs.name: failMode
inputs.label: Fail mode
inputs.helpMarkDown: When to fail the task based on the decision result.

options.nonEmpty: Fail when the decision set/array is non-empty (deny convention)
options.defined: Fail when the decision is defined and truthy

inputs.name: defaultEnforcementLevel
inputs.label: Enforcement level
inputs.helpMarkDown: Enforcement level applied to generated policy config (ignored when a custom sentinel.hcl is supplied).

inputs.name: overrideSoftMandatory
inputs.label: Override soft-mandatory failures
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled, soft-mandatory policy failures warn but do not fail the task.

inputs.name: sentinelImportName
inputs.label: Static import name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the static import that exposes the plan JSON to policies (import "<name>").

inputs.name: sentinelConfigPath
inputs.label: Custom sentinel.hcl path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Use an existing sentinel.hcl instead of generating one. The task then gates purely on the exit code.

inputs.name: traceOutput
inputs.label: Trace output
inputs.helpMarkDown: Run sentinel apply with -trace for verbose debugging output.

inputs.name: publishTestResults
inputs.label: Publish results to Tests tab
inputs.helpMarkDown: Publish a JUnit report so policy outcomes appear in the pipeline Tests tab.

inputs.name: sarifOutput
inputs.label: Write a SARIF report
inputs.helpMarkDown: Write a SARIF 2.1.0 report of policy violations and expose its path via the `sarifFilePath` output variable. Publish it as a build artifact to surface findings in SARIF-aware tooling.

inputs.name: sarifPath
inputs.label: SARIF output path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional explicit path for the SARIF report. When empty, a file is written to the agent temp directory; either way its path is exposed via the `sarifFilePath` output variable.

outputVariables.name: violationCount
outputVariables.description: The number of policy violations found.

outputVariables.name: resultsFilePath
outputVariables.description: Path to the raw engine output written to the agent temp directory.

outputVariables.name: sarifFilePath
outputVariables.description: Path to the SARIF 2.1.0 report (set only when 'Write a SARIF report' is enabled).

messages.InsecureUrlRejected: Insecure URL rejected: %s. Only HTTPS URLs are allowed.
messages.PolicyRepoUrlUserInfoRejected: The policy repository URL carries credentials in its userinfo (https://user:password@host/...): %s. A URL credential is written to the git child process's command line, which other processes on a shared agent can read and which the agent's secret masker does not cover. Remove the credentials from policyRepoUrl and supply them through the policyRepoToken input instead, which delivers them to git out of band.
messages.InvalidPolicyRepoRef: Invalid policy repo ref rejected: %s. Refs must not start with '-' and may contain only letters, digits, '.', '_', '/', and '-'.
messages.PolicySubdirOutsideRepo: Policy subdirectory escapes the cloned repository: %s
messages.PolicyRepoCloneTimedOut: Cloning the policy repository timed out after %s ms.
messages.PolicyEngineTimedOut: The %s process exceeded its %s ms wall-clock timeout and was terminated. This usually indicates a hung or pathological policy evaluation (e.g. a malformed bundle or a runaway policy); inspect the policy set and input.
